summary.text: A car waits in darkness, starts, and then pulls forward as its headlights sweep the road.

description.text: A low, nearly ground-level view holds on a parked car facing the camera in near-total darkness. Its body is a dark silhouette, with the windshield, hood, and front bumper only faintly separated from the surrounding black; the tires rest on a smooth asphalt surface whose faint sheen catches the smallest trace of ambient light. The headlights are off. The framing stays low and fixed, letting a held beat of black shape the reveal before any motion. After a quiet pause, the ignition catches with a small mechanical snap; a low engine rumble begins and settles into a steady pulse. The car's outline firms slightly as vibration passes through the frame, but the vehicle does not yet move, preserving the tension between the waiting body and the first sign of power. The framing stays close, keeping the ground ahead as a narrow band of shadow and the surrounding space almost entirely unlit.
A parked car faces the camera in near-total darkness, its headlights off and body reduced to a low silhouette on asphalt.
A small mechanical catch signals the ignition turning over, followed by a low engine rumble building into a steady pulse.
The car's silhouette firms slightly as the engine vibration runs through the body, but the car stays parked.
The camera holds a static shot.

The view cuts to a medium-wide framing as the car pulls forward out of the dark. At first its nose breaks the shadow, then the headlights snap on and throw two clean beams across the ground ahead; the light catches texture in the asphalt and pushes the surrounding black back. The body emerges into faint ambient light, enough to show the hood, windshield, and front wheels rolling as the rear of the car clears the space where it was parked. The framing tightens slowly, moving in with small amplitude at slow speed on the advancing car without overtaking it. A faint reflection travels along the roofline as the beams sweep the path ahead. The engine rumble rises in a steady low pulse, and the tires make a soft scrape as they roll. The car continues forward, now fully committed to the move, its beams sweeping the bare road while the darkness closes behind it and the low pulse keeps the timing of the cut and the motion.
The car pulls forward out of the dark, its nose breaking the shadow first.
The headlights snap on and throw two clean beams across the asphalt ahead.
The engine rumble rises in a steady low pulse while the tires scrape softly on the ground.
The car continues forward, its body fully clear of the parked shadow, with the darkness closing behind it.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
